name: Gnome Engineering
label: Quest
description: Gnome Engineering: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin. Gnome engineering represents by far the superior of the two! It's about the construction of wonderful gadgets and devices that make life better!

Friend, read this manual. If you want to learn more on gnome engineering, then take that manual to Tinkmaster Overspark here in Ironforge. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, yes, what needs of yours might I address today? Clearly, I have the time to do such since all I do is stand here while our beloved city lies in a cloud of irradiated death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a young engineer interested in pursuing the one, true discipline of engineering! Well forgive my melodrama, friend. While our situation remains dire, it still is always a good day to see another engineer respond to the clarion call of true engineering!
